notes: Manufacturer's own DM170 tech-specs page no longer exists on the live flandersscientific.com (DM170 has been superseded in FSI's current lineup by models like DM160/DM211/DM231/DM242; live URL 404s), so sourced via the Wayback Machine's 2021-03-02 capture of that same manufacturer page — content and formatting confirm it is FSI's authentic spec sheet, not a reseller reproduction. Cross-checked against a Rentex-hosted FSI spec-sheet PDF (https://www.rentex.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/17-Flanders-Scientific-DM170-Spec-Sheet-from-Rentex-1.pdf) which agrees on all overlapping fields (screen size, bit depth, contrast, DC In "4 PIN XLR", AC In "IEC/C14", power draw, weight). SDI is confirmed 3Gbps/HD/SD-SDI (grade sdi-3g) for the 2 BNC inputs and the 2 BNC loop-through outputs; the 2 "2nd Monitor Output" BNCs are listed without a restated grade on the spec sheet, so sdi-3g is inferred there (noted per-port) rather than confirmed word-for-word. DVI-D input and DisplayPort input have no HDMI/DP version stated, so grade was omitted per instructions. A third-party listing (AV-iQ) additionally claims USB host/device ports and RS-232/RS-485 control, but these do NOT appear on FSI's own DM170 spec page, so they were excluded rather than guessed — flag this if USB/serial control ports are needed and cannot be confirmed elsewhere. Audio In/Out are 3.5mm mini-jack (mapped to trs-3.5) for disembedded SDI audio monitoring, not primary program audio I/O. rackUnits omitted: FSI ships DM170 with a "Standard" desktop stand and a "Standard" rack mount kit, but no rack-unit (U) height is published for this bench/utility monitor, so it reads as a desktop-primary unit here.
